subject: Commercial milestones, PO timing and invoicing cadence for Acme evaluation
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finalizing commercial terms & PO timing for evaluation

Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of items before we sign the MAP:

- Preferred payment terms you can accept (Net30 vs Net60).
- Do you require a PO before you start billing, or can billing begin at go-live and we submit PO later?
- Invoicing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and remittance details so we can route to AP.
- Any discounts or ramp credits tied to committed volumes or ramp milestones.

We want to align timing with our internal finance cycle. Target for evaluation -> production ramp is mid-August, but contract approval will depend on PO issuance timing. Can you send a short summary we can share with Procurement?

Jordan
Procurement, Acme Analytics

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing commercial terms & PO timing for evaluation

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick note. I summarized our proposal below so Procurement has a single doc to review. Attaching the MAP (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf) and the accompanying quote.

High-level commercial summary (proposal):
- Payment terms: Standard Net30.
- We can accept Net60 for enterprise customers that provide a PO before billing starts; in that case we require monthly invoicing.
- PO requirement: Preferred prior to first invoice for Net60. For Net30 we can bill on first monthly invoice and accept a subsequent PO if needed (finance approval required).
- Billing start: Billing will begin on the later of (a) receipt of customer PO (if PO is required to start billing) or (b) the first production-ready endpoint activation date.
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly by default; quarterly invoicing available for pre-agreed deals.
- Discounts: 10% off list at >=3M tokens/month committed; 15% at >=10M tokens/month. Ramp credit of $12,000 applied to first invoice if go-live occurs within 60 days of contract signature.

Mutual action plan (MAP) milestones (proposed):
1) Week 0: MAP sign + PO submission (if required) — sign SOW/DocuSign.
2) Week 1–2: Evaluation kickoff (test data + sandbox endpoints).
3) Week 3–4: Mid-eval review (performance & cost review).
4) Week 5–8: Production readiness & ramp commit (customer commits tokens/throughput).
5) Go-live: Production endpoint activation -> billing start per rule above.

If Procurement wants Net60 + PO up front, we can do that; I noted the requirement that PO arrives prior to first invoice. If they prefer Net30 we can be flexible and accept PO after first invoice with finance sign-off.

Next steps: I can push the final MAP + quote into DocuSign today if you confirm Net30 vs Net60 preference and whether AP will issue PO before billing.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing commercial terms & PO timing for evaluation

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary. Procurement's response below:

- Acme policy prefers Net60 for new vendor arrangements of this size. We can provide a signed PO (PO-ACME-9271) prior to first invoice.
- Invoicing cadence: monthly invoices are required for our systems.
- Billing start: Procurement will only sign PO with an explicit billing start date; can you commit to a billing trigger tied to production activation (we prefer that) or a calendar date that follows PO by X days?

We attached the draft PO (ACME_PO-9271.pdf) for your review. Can Finance confirm acceptance of Net60 + PO-first flow and acknowledge remittance details? We can route DocuSign once you confirm the billing trigger.

Jordan

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing commercial terms & PO timing for evaluation

Quick internal note — Finance is generally OK with Net60 when a PO is received in advance. Two operational asks:
- We should require PO number on the invoice for AP match.
- Recommend final billing start language: "Billing begins on the later of (i) the date Redwood receives a signed PO and (ii) the date Redwood activates the customer's first production endpoint." That protects both sides and aligns with our invoice generation.

If Procurement insists on an earlier fixed calendar start, we should limit that to a mutually-agreed date in the SOW. Otherwise the later-of approach is clean.

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing commercial terms & PO timing for evaluation (Agreed summary & next steps)

Jordan / Procurement —

Thanks — this is helpful. Per our internal review we can accept the Net60 + PO-first flow with the following final items to include in the SOW / MAP and DocuSign:

Agreed commercial terms (final):
- Payment terms: Net60 (approved for this deal).
- PO requirement: Acme to provide PO (PO-ACME-9271) prior to first invoice. Redwood will not issue an invoice until PO is received or production endpoint is activated and a mutually-agreed exception is signed.
- Billing start trigger: Billing begins on the later of: (a) date Redwood receives a signed customer PO, or (b) date Redwood activates the customer's first production-ready endpoint.
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly invoices sent to AP (Acme) with PO number included on the invoice for matching.
- Discounts & ramp credit: 10% discount at >=3M tokens/month commit; 15% at >=10M tokens/month commit. One-time ramp credit of $12,000 applied to the first invoice if go-live occurs within 60 days of DocuSign completion.

Attachments: final MAP and commercial quote attached. DocuSign link below for signature. Once we get the signed MAP + PO we will schedule the evaluation kickoff.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw/ACME-RDW-SOW-2026
Drive (MAP): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Acme/MAP-Redwood-v3

Next steps (owner + ETA):
- Acme: Confirm and return signed PO (PO-ACME-9271) — requested by 2026-07-21 (Jordan).
- Acme: Sign DocuSign SOW (Jordan/Sarah) — requested by 2026-07-21.
- Redwood: Activate sandbox endpoints within 2 business days of signed SOW and PO (Ben).
- Redwood: Apply ramp credit on first invoice if go-live within 60 days (Finance).

If that looks good I'll send the DocuSign envelope now and loop Legal if any redlines come back on SOW.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments referenced: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf, Quote_ACME_Q3.xlsx, ACME_PO-9271.pdf
